paragraph: A conservation nonprofit called American Prairie has been working for more than twenty years across the Great Plains of North America. This autumn their resident herd of relatively free-roaming bison crossed a threshold they had not reached since the organization began. The herd now numbers in four digits, with more than one thousand animals roaming the grasslands. It is the largest private land conservation project in the country. Some patience, some space, and the ground holds what once was nearly gone.

seed.summary: As autumn descends upon the Great Plains of North America, the largest private land conservation project in the country is ringing in an inspirational milestone.
